_note: Sample OPERATOR-SIDE evaluation policy override for tools/Invoke-ReviewerEvaluation.ps1 -PolicyFile. Every floor and cap here is stricter than or equal to the shipped default, which is the only direction that has any effect: ConvertTo-ReviewerEvalEffectivePolicy clamps every cap DOWN to its code ceiling and every floor UP to its code floor, so a permissive value is silently ignored. One value is NOT clamped and is genuinely operator-chosen: the length of qualifiableScopes is the Bonferroni k, so a shorter list is a WEAKER multiplicity correction as well as narrower per-scope evidence. Declare every scope you intend to qualify, before looking at any numbers - this sample declares both important and critical, matching the shipped default. Note what is absent: partitionSalt, adjudicationSalt and holdoutPercent belong to the sealed corpus freeze and the harness throws if a policy file even mentions them. This file cannot enable a delivery gate, sign anything, or make suggestions unattended.
